name: Can I skip post-repair leak testing to save money?

mainEntity.name: Can I skip post-repair leak testing to save money?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it might seem like a way to save money upfront, skipping post-repair leak testing is not recommended. This step is a critical safeguard against future, potentially more expensive problems. An undetected leak, even a small one, can lead to significant water damage, mold growth, structural compromise, and higher utility bills down the line. The cost of repairing these secondary damages far outweighs the cost of proper testing. Investing in thorough post-repair testing provides peace of mind and protects your property from unforeseen complications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Skipping post-repair leak testing is not advisable. It's a critical safeguard that prevents costly future water damage, mold, and structural issues.
